fachhochschule-dortmund--film-sound--bac.name: Film & Sound
fachhochschule-dortmund--film-sound--bac.description: Seven-semester project-based program in which students from the two tracks Film and Sounddesign jointly realize fictional, documentary, and experimental film projects, learning audiovisual storytelling from idea to realization. Admission via aptitude assessment (Eignungsfeststellung); starts in the winter semester.

fachhochschule-dortmund--digital-design-.name: Digital Design
fachhochschule-dortmund--digital-design-.description: Master's program in the computer science faculty for students with a design or computing background, focused on holistically well-designed digital solutions across Gestaltungslehre, Baulehre, Entwurfslehre, and Materialkunde. Admission via aptitude assessment and a minimum grade of 2.5; starts in the winter semester.

fachhochschule-dortmund--fotografie--bac.name: Fotografie
fachhochschule-dortmund--fotografie--bac.description: Seven-semester bachelor's program covering technical skills from analog photography to post-photographic and AI-assisted processes, with foundation year followed by specialization from the third semester. Admission via aptitude assessment; starts in the winter semester.

fachhochschule-dortmund--visuelle-kommun.name: Visuelle Kommunikation
fachhochschule-dortmund--visuelle-kommun.description: Successor to the discontinued Kommunikationsdesign program: visual design of content for analog, digital, and interactive media, including corporate design, book/magazine/poster design, campaign development, packaging, illustration, web design, game design, and interaction design. Admission via aptitude assessment; starts in the winter semester.

fachhochschule-dortmund--film-hybrid-non.name: Film - Hybrid & Non-Fiction
fachhochschule-dortmund--film-hybrid-non.description: Three-semester consecutive master's program realizing a film project from conception through production to post-production, aiming at a 'design of the real'; together with the Film & Sound bachelor it holds film school status in the international CILECT association. Admission via aptitude assessment; starts in the summer semester.
specializations: Film (Regie, Kamera, Schnitt, Produktion, Drehbuch, Dramaturgie)

fachhochschule-dortmund--objekt-und-raum.name: Objekt- und Raumdesign
fachhochschule-dortmund--objekt-und-raum.description: Seven-semester practice-oriented project program in three-dimensional storytelling — staging spaces and objects for shops, trade fairs, interiors, film, stage, museums, and public space. Admission via aptitude assessment; starts in the winter semester.

fachhochschule-dortmund--editorial-desig.name: Editorial Design
fachhochschule-dortmund--editorial-desig.description: Three-semester inter- and crossmedial master's program centered on visual research, authorship, and medium-specific discourse in editorial design, integrating analog and digital print techniques, VR, photography, and film workshops. Admission via aptitude assessment; starts in the summer semester.

leuphana-universitat-luneburg--cultural-.name: Cultural Studies: Media and Digital Cultures
leuphana-universitat-luneburg--cultural-.description: Interdisciplinary cultural studies programme examining digital cultures in their dynamics and consequences. Four core modules in history, philosophy, social organization, and aesthetics are combined with electives on phenomena such as democracy, gender, organization, media technology, and urban infrastructure. Taught in German with some electives in English; 25 study places per cohort.

requirements.label: academic
requirements.text: 60 ECTS in modules relevant to humanities or sociology plus 10 ECTS in scientific theory and scientific methods.

bergische-universitat-wuppertal--mediend.name: Mediendesign und Designtechnik (Kombi-Bachelor)
bergische-universitat-wuppertal--mediend.description: Combined bachelor programme in media design and design technology, taken together with a second subject (typically toward vocational-school teaching). Covers design fundamentals, visual communication, typography, media and design technology, and design history and theory. No numerus clausus, but a passed aptitude assessment (Eignungsfeststellungsverfahren) is required; winter intake with enrolment by 15 October.

bergische-universitat-wuppertal--mediend.name: Mediendesign und Designtechnik (Kombi-Master)
bergische-universitat-wuppertal--mediend.description: Master of Education in media design and design technology combined with a second subject and educational science, preparing for teaching at vocational colleges (Berufskolleg). Open admission (zulassungsfrei); entry in winter or summer semester.

fachhochschule-munster--mediendesign-und.name: Mediendesign und Designtechnik (Lehramt an Berufskollegs)
fachhochschule-munster--mediendesign-und.description: Cooperative teacher-training bachelor of FH Münster (Münster School of Design) and the University of Münster, preparing for teaching media design and design technology at vocational colleges. No admission restriction, but a passed design aptitude test (Eignungsprüfung) is required; students enrol at both institutions. Winter intake.

goethe-universitat-frankfurt-am-main--th.name: Theater-, Film- und Medienwissenschaft
goethe-universitat-frankfurt-am-main--th.description: Open-admission (zulassungsfrei) MA on forms of representation in theater, film, and media, integrating philosophical, art-theoretical, historical, sociological, and cultural-economic perspectives. Requires two modern foreign languages at A2 (or Latin/Greek plus one modern language) and at least four weeks of internship in the theater, film, or media field. Winter intake.

hochschule-offenburg--communication-and-.name: Communication and Media Engineering
hochschule-offenburg--communication-and-.description: English-taught engineering MSc (120 ECTS) covering advanced communication technologies, IoT systems, signal processing, wireless networks, AI and machine learning applications, media systems, and IT security, with electives in hardware, software, or management. Winter intake; EU residents apply by 15 July, non-EU residents by 31 March. Non-EU students pay 1,500 EUR tuition per semester (TOEFL iBT 79 / IELTS 6.0 required).

fees.notes: Administrative fee €80 + social contribution €65 + student government €25 + flat-rate international service fee €150 = €320/semester.

requirements.label: academic
requirements.text: completed bachelor's degree in a related field, APS (for applicants from China, India, and Vietnam)

carl-von-ossietzky-universitat-oldenburg.name: Art and Media (Zwei-Fächer-Bachelor)
carl-von-ossietzky-universitat-oldenburg.description: Dual-subject bachelor combining theory and history of art, visual culture, and modern art and media production with aesthetic practice. Open admission (NC-free) but with an entrance examination of theoretical and practical tasks, to be submitted by 1 June of the admission year. Winter intake; taken as major (60 ECTS) or minor (30 ECTS) alongside a second subject.

universitat-bremen--digital-media-and-so.name: Digital Media and Society
universitat-bremen--digital-media-and-so.description: English-taught MA (120 ECTS) on digitalization and datafication and their societal impact, combining digital media theory, empirical communication research methods, and practical media work. Specialization areas include digital literacy, media conception, data analysis, and project management in datafied societies. Restricted admission; winter intake.

universitat-bremen--digitale-medien--mas.name: Digitale Medien
universitat-bremen--digitale-medien--mas.description: Joint English-taught Digital Media master of HfK Bremen and Universität Bremen. This listing is the Media Informatics (Medieninformatik) profile, awarded as Master of Science. Apply for the chosen profile at its respective institution; the partner profile has a different award.

application_route.notes: Apply electronically through the portal of the institution awarding your chosen profile: HfK Bremen for Media Design (M.A.), Universität Bremen for Media Informatics (M.Sc.). Include the required work samples and motivation letter. Confirm any foreign-credential checks with that institution.

requirements.label: first degree
requirements.text: At least 180 ECTS in digital media, computer science, design, media technology, media studies or a related/comparable programme. Conditional applications are possible with at least 150 ECTS already completed.

requirements.label: selection
requirements.text: An overall assessment of 2.5 or better under the admission regulations, plus a motivation letter and a portfolio of relevant work. The 2.5 threshold refers to the regulated overall assessment, not just the bachelor grade.

universitat-bremen--digitale-medien--bac.name: Digitale Medien
universitat-bremen--digitale-medien--bac.description: Program focusing on digital media with emphasis on practical and theoretical knowledge. Joint program of Hochschule für Künste Bremen and Universität Bremen. Offered jointly with Hochschule für Künste Bremen.

universitat-hamburg--liberal-arts-and-sc.name: Liberal Arts and Sciences
universitat-hamburg--liberal-arts-and-sc.description: Interdisciplinary liberal-arts bachelor in the Faculty of Humanities, taught in German and English over eight semesters. Admission is restricted (NC); winter intake. No tuition fees beyond the semester contribution.

europa-universitat-flensburg--kultur-spr.name: Kultur – Sprache – Medien
europa-universitat-flensburg--kultur-spr.description: MA (120 ECTS) combining six disciplines: art/visual culture, cultural studies, media studies, literary studies, linguistics, and intercultural business administration, with a focus on the cultures of German-, Scandinavian-, and English-speaking countries around the Baltic, North Sea, and North Atlantic. Open admission (zulassungsfrei); German C1 required.

fees.notes: Keine Studiengebühren

heinrich-heine-universitat-dusseldorf--k.name: Kunstvermittlung und Kulturmanagement
heinrich-heine-universitat-dusseldorf--k.description: MA (120 ECTS) in art mediation and cultural management, combining art history with practice-oriented training for museums, galleries, cultural institutions, and the art market. Admission via aptitude assessment; winter intake.

status.notes: Active Master of Arts program.

deutsche-film-und-fernsehakademie-berlin.name: Film Directing
deutsche-film-und-fernsehakademie-berlin.description: Full-time film directing training at DFFB. The award is DFFB’s own non-state diploma, not a university Bachelor, Master or academic Diplom. German is required; some seminars are taught in English. The 2027/28 application requires registration before the later assignment-submission deadline.
